t: This is 74 St James's Street, a Grade II* listed building in St James's. It was built to house the Conservative Club and has since been converted to offices. Two architects are credited with designing it. George Basevi, a pupil of Sir John Soane, is best known for Belgrave Square and the Fitzwilliam Museum in Cambridge. Sydney Smirke was also a British architect. Take a moment to look up at the facade of a club building from the grand age of St James's.
